(defn- ordered
  [interval]
  (let [start (get interval "start")
        finish (get interval "end")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {"start" start "end" finish}
      {"start" finish "end" start})))

(defn- touches?
  [current next tolerance]
  (< (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") tolerance)))

(defn- extend
  [current next]
  {"start" (get current "start")
   "end" (max (get current "end") (get next "end"))})

(defn- merge-ordered
  [intervals tolerance]
  (reduce
    (fn [merged interval]
      (if (empty? merged)
        [interval]
        (let [current (last merged)]
          (if (touches? current interval tolerance)
            (conj (vec (butlast merged)) (extend current interval))
            (conj merged interval)))))
    []
    intervals))

(defn merge-with-tolerance
  [input]
  (let [tolerance (get input "tolerance" 0)
        intervals (map ordered (get input "intervals" []))
        sorted (sort-by #(get % "start") intervals)]
    {"intervals" (merge-ordered sorted tolerance)}))

;; Test: intervals with gap exactly = tolerance
(def test1 (merge-with-tolerance {"intervals" [{"start" 1 "end" 5} {"start" 7 "end" 10}], "tolerance" 2}))
(println "Test gap=2 tol=2:" test1)

;; Test: intervals with gap exactly = tolerance (touching with tolerance=0)
(def test2 (merge-with-tolerance {"intervals" [{"start" 1 "end" 5} {"start" 5 "end" 10}], "tolerance" 0}))
(println "Test touching tol=0:" test2)

;; Test the specific case from index 3
(def test3 (merge-with-tolerance {"intervals" [{"start" 1 "end" 5} {"start" 6 "end" 10}], "tolerance" 1}))
(println "Test gap=1 tol=1:" test3)

(defn- ordered
  "Put one interval into ascending endpoint order."
  [interval]
  (let [start (get interval "start")
        finish (get interval "end")]
    (if (<= start finish)
      {"start" start "end" finish}
      {"start" finish "end" start})))

(defn- touches?
  "Return true when the next interval is within tolerance."
  [current next tolerance]
  (<= (get next "start")
      (+ (get current "end") tolerance)))

(defn- extend
  "Extend a merged interval without moving its start."
  [current next]
  {"start" (get current "start")
   "end" (max (get current "end") (get next "end"))})

(defn- merge-ordered
  "Merge an already sorted sequence."
  [intervals tolerance]
  (reduce
    (fn [merged interval]
      (if (empty? merged)
        [interval]
        (let [current (last merged)]
          (if (touches? current interval tolerance)
            (conj (vec (butlast merged)) (extend current interval))
            (conj merged interval)))))
    []
    intervals))

(defn merge-with-tolerance
  "Normalise and merge intervals whose gap is no greater than tolerance."
  {:signature "(input :map) -> :map"}
  [input]
  (let [tolerance (get input "tolerance" 0)
        intervals (map ordered (get input "intervals" []))
        sorted (sort-by #(get % "start") intervals)]
    (return {"intervals" (merge-ordered sorted tolerance)})))
